verdict.rationale: Fin documents escalation guidance and rules plus guidance controls, and it can transfer conversations to human agents in the inbox. That implies ops leads can route sensitive topics such as legal, cancellations and security to humans. The evidence is mostly article titles, though, with no detail on how topic-based human-only rules are set up or enforced. Missing for 10: documented topic-level human-only routing configuration, evidence that escalation rules deterministically stop Fin from answering on those topics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
